statement.zh: 发掘回忆录传统将库鲁、努里等墓地作为纳帕塔王室埋葬序列的关键证据（Dunham MFA 传统；UNESCO 1073）。
statement.en: Excavation memoir tradition treats cemeteries such as El-Kurru and Nuri as key evidence for Napatan royal burial sequences (Dunham MFA tradition; UNESCO 1073).
